blockers.title: Ownership check removed: readRecord returns any user's record value instead of throwing Forbidden
blockers.reason: The PR deletes the `record.ownerId !== user.id` guard and puts no check anywhere else. As a result, `readRecord` now returns `{ id, value }` to a user who does not own the record. This breaks the README.md:3-5 contract that non-owners get Forbidden before any value is returned, and it lets any user read other users' data.
blockers.fix: Restore `if (record.ownerId !== user.id) throw new Error('Forbidden');` as the first statement of `readRecord`, before the return.
blockers.validation: Add a test: `readRecord({ id: 'u2' }, { id: 'r1', ownerId: 'u1', value: 'secret' })` should throw `Error('Forbidden')`, and `readRecord({ id: 'u1' }, { id: 'r1', ownerId: 'u1', value: 'secret' })` should return exactly `{ id: 'r1', value: 'secret' }`.
